agent.name: Web Master
agent.description: Your personal web developer intern. It builds your website, writes blog posts, manages your data, sends you reports, and updates anything on demand — just tell it what you need.
agent.vibe: designs it, builds it, ships it

scripts.build: npm config set prefix "$HOME/.npm-global" && npm install -g agent-browser && "$HOME/.npm-global/bin/agent-browser" install && (grep -q '^PATH=' "$HERMES_HOME/.env" 2>/dev/null || echo "PATH=$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH" >> "$HERMES_HOME/.env") && (grep -q '^AGENT_BROWSER_ARGS=' "$HERMES_HOME/.env" 2>/dev/null || echo 'AGENT_BROWSER_ARGS=--no-sandbox,--disable-setuid-sandbox' >> "$HERMES_HOME/.env") && cd workspace/projects/astro-app && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.start: cd workspace/projects/astro-app && HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=4321 node dist/server/entry.mjs
